name: project-reporting-studio
description: Prepare project updates and review slide decks, supporting data, and handoff materials.

com.github.xubaodian.agent-cook.instructions: Build project updates around milestone progress, risks and dependencies, decisions needed, and next actions. Use the data reviewer when source rows and metrics need reconciliation. For files under out/report/, write out/report/validation.json with a files array of all workspace-relative deliverable paths and a checks object whose values reflect the checks you ran.
